name: Research - Budget Scaling and Stronger National Traits
description: One research package (merged from Research Budget Scaling and Stronger Research Advantages). Research Budget Scaling - No Stalled Projects: Research setbacks no longer halve a project's accumulated progress; they cost that turn's gain, keeping the native messages and ahead-of-era slowdowns. This removes the stall where projects 3+ years ahead hover far below cost for hundreds of turns. Research effort above the native 20%-of-cost per-turn limit still counts at 50%, up to 60% of cost per turn, so a bigger budget keeps speeding research. The national point total saturates instead of wrapping negative at extreme budgets or research speeds. Same rules for player and AI; no save values, priorities or research speed edited. Restart through Play with mods. Gameplay balance unverified. See Mods/Manager/RESEARCH_BUDGET.md. Stronger Research Advantages and Technical Excellence: National ResearchNAdvantage flags add a steady 50% to positive research effort in their own branch. TechnicalExcellence adds 25% across all research branches, including gun research. These extra percentages add: both give +75%, before the remaining native random modifiers, era/prerequisite checks and progress limits. Existing national bonuses stay intact. Same rules for player and AI; no trait flags, research speed, budgets, completed technologies, save files or ship/aircraft performance are edited. Integer rounding and native limits can reduce the visible gain. Optional values are configurable in this manifest; restart through Play with mods. Gameplay balance remains unverified. See Mods/Manager/RESEARCH_TRAITS.md.
